Usage: ocfl stage rm <path> [flags]

Remove a file or directory from the stage

Arguments:
  <path>    file or directory to remove

Flags:
  -h, --help                      Show context-sensitive help.
      --root=STRING               The prefix/directory of the OCFL storage root
                                  used for the command ($OCFL_ROOT)
      --debug                     enable debug log messages

  -f, --file="ocfl-stage.json"    path to stage file

  -r, --recursive                 remove all files in the directory
